name: data-pipeline
title: Data pipeline
summary: Every table has an owner, a schema check and a freshness check.

rules.text: A schema change ships with its migration.
rules.why: a schema that changes without its migration breaks every job that reads the old shape.

rules.text: A failed job names the rows and the reason.
rules.why: a failure that names no rows means rerunning everything to find what broke.
